newsitem.title: USA: US Plains cattle trading turns active at $70-trade.
newsitem.headline: US Plains cattle trading turns active at $70-trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle trading turned active Wednesday afternoon at $70.00 per cwt with about 30,000 head reported sold in the Texas Panhandle area and 12,000 to 20,000 in Kansas, feedlot sources said.
The $70.00 is down $2.00 from last week's top prices.
Feedlot sources said the selling began about 1300 CST and accelerated through the afternoon. By late afternoon the packers appeared to have pulled bids, they said.
A Texas feedlot manager said he would sell cattle at $70.00, but the meat packers he contacted were no longer offering it.
One Kansas manager said packers need more cattle for immediate slaughter needs and should resume bidding $70.00 Thursday.
"I don't think they have enough cattle to satisfy their needs," he said.
